# DECIFER

> DECIFER is an AI intelligence company. It builds products that turn complex information into clear, plain-language understanding. DECIFER (all caps) is the parent brand; its products are named in title case. Current products: Decifer Trading, Decifer Learning and Decifer Marketing.

DECIFER's method is the same across every product: collect trusted inputs, connect them with domain-specific logic, and explain the result in plain language while keeping sources and uncertainty visible. DECIFER is designed to support human judgement, not replace it.

Primary site: https://www.decifer.io

## Products

- [Decifer Trading](https://decifertrading.com): Market intelligence (Live). Turns market noise into a plain-English read on what is moving, why it matters and what to watch, across stocks, themes and catalysts. Boundary: for intelligence and research context only. Not financial advice.
- [Decifer Learning](https://deciferlearning.com): Learning intelligence (Beta). A guided companion for the UK National Curriculum. Children learn, practise and quiz through each topic while parents see progress. Boundary: supports learning. Does not replace teachers, schools or parents.
- [Decifer Marketing](https://decifermarketing.com): Marketing intelligence (Live). Turns campaign, channel and audience data into a plain-English read on what is working, why, and what to do next. Boundary: for insight and research context only. Not a substitute for professional marketing advice.

## Notes

- DECIFER is a company name, spelled with an e. It is related to the word decipher but refers to the company and its products, not the dictionary word.
- Contact: hello@decifer.io
